episodes.title: The Cellar
episodes.summary: While restoring an old Iowa farmhouse, Sam discovers a time portal in the storm cellar that transports him to 1919.

episodes.title: The Heat
episodes.summary: Tuka and Sterling are best friends whose bond transcends the physical world as they follow their dreams after tragedy strikes.

episodes.title: Dynoman and the Volt
episodes.summary: An awkward young boy and his grandfather are transformed by the arrival of a mysterious ring ordered from a comic book 60 years ago.

episodes.title: Signs of Life
episodes.summary: When her mother awakes from a six-year coma, teenage Alia struggles to reconnect with this stranger who can't remember her old life.

episodes.title: The Rift
episodes.summary: When a WWII pilot crashes in modern-day Ohio, a young widow and her stepson are swept up in his search for home.
